LESSON: READING THREE TO FOUR LETTER WORDS

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.8: Reading three to four letter words

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Reading three to four letter words. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate ability to blend syllables to read three to four letter words in and out of class. letter words in pairs and
2. Read three to four letter words correctly in and out of class. activities to read three to
3. Enjoy participating in activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate ability to blend syllables to read three to four letter words in and out of class. letter words in pairs and
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate ability to blend syllables to read three to four letter words in and out of class. letter words in pairs and. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Read three to four letter words correctly in and out of class. activities to read three to
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to read three to four letter words correctly in and out of class. activities to read three to. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Enjoy participating in activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy participating in activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Reading three to four letter words.
2. Explain Reading three to four letter words to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading three to four letter words.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate ability to blend syllables to read three to four letter words in and out of class. letter words in pairs and
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading three to four letter words. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Reading three to four letter words important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate ability to blend syllables to read three to four letter words in and out of class. letter words in pairs and
2. Read three to four letter words correctly in and out of class. activities to read three to
3. Enjoy participating in activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
